name: Hakamada Youhei
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'harmony among siblings' on his body.
He has an eager and pure personality.
A hard worker, but he is often just making a fruitless effort.
But he also has a side that hates to be alone and you just want to protect him.
